title: JSON insertion and replacement dispatch with argument errors

scope.rationale: jsonWrongNumArgs, jsonReplaceFunc, and jsonSetFunc form the registered JSON edit dispatch boundary. Replacement and user-data-selected insert, set, or array-insert behaviors share exact odd-argument validation across JSON and JSONB public prepared SQL paths.
excluded_responsibilities: jsonInsertIntoBlob parsing and edit execution body

external_source_responsibilities: jsonInsertIntoBlob owns parse/edit/result behavior for the selected edit type
Function registry supplies exact source user-data flag topology
VDBE Mem result owner publishes copied error text
dependencies.caller_closure: All three assigned source bodies are complete. Public and internal registries invoke replacement and insertion-family callbacks; reportWrongArgumentCount serves every even-argument validation branch.

inputs: SQLite function context, argument count, argument vector, and JSON insertion user-data flags
Borrowed insertion operation name for argument error rendering
outputs: No result for fewer than one argument, exact odd-argument error, or dispatch to the selected insertion edit type
contracts.ownership: Arguments and context are borrowed. Error text is rendered into bounded stack storage and copied by the VDBE result owner before return.
contracts.state_and_results: User-data bits 2-3 select insert, set, or array_insert. Even counts publish the matching json_NAME() message. Odd counts call the shared insertion owner with JEDIT_INS, JEDIT_SET, or JEDIT_AINS.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks or I/O. One internal function callback dispatch occurs after validation.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Message rendering has a bounded fallback to no-memory publication. Invalid insertion flag values violate the source registry invariant and assertion. Insertion failures are owned by jsonInsertIntoBlob.

representation_differences: A bounded stack buffer plus std.fmt replaces sqlite3_mprintf allocation; VDBE resultError copies bytes synchronously.
Typed slices and arrays replace source C string and static pointer/edit arrays.
The public frontend registry now carries the same insert/set/array-insert bits as the canonical internal registry, with JSONB format bit 0x10 composed independently.

oracle.protocol: Execute json_replace over existing and missing paths, json_insert, json_set, and json_array_insert through prepared SQL. Exercise even argument counts for all names and compare exact errors.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact JSON output and error text.

assurance.oom: Bounded rendering does not allocate; insertion-owner OOM remains published by its existing typed path.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Connection-local function execution; no I/O or shared state.
assurance.malformed_input: Malformed JSON/path handling remains in the insertion owner. Even count is rejected before dereferencing missing pairs.
assurance.continuation: Validation errors leave the connection and statement safely finalizable; successful dispatch returns one independent result.
assurance.performance: Constant dispatch and bounded message rendering before the existing insertion traversal.

integration.production_owner: src/core/internal/json_functions.zig registered callback and src/core/sql_frontend.zig public function registry
integration.native_call_path: Prepared SQL resolves json_replace/jsonb_replace and insertion-family names; callbacks validate counts and dispatch JEDIT_REPL, JEDIT_INS, JEDIT_SET, or JEDIT_AINS to insertIntoBlob.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The public registry's set-only callback configuration is retired in favor of complete insertion-family registration and flag dispatch.

independent_review.notes: Requires exact error differential, broader insertion-family differential, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add maintained pinned-C argument-error and insertion-family differential trace.
